notes:
Texting beta 3: reminders and confirmations by text.

- The appointment timeline's text steps now send: text reminder, second text reminder, text confirmation (with a second ask if it's ignored), same-day text, and a new optional new-patient text with the forms link.
- Every text step starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Settings → Patient email.
- A family's texts for the same day go in one text, one timeline text a day per phone, only inside Settings → Texting's hours and never on its no-text days.
- A confirmation text carries the confirm link and sets "Diastema texted". A patient who replies C is confirmed the same way as tapping Confirm, with Undo in Follow-ups → Confirmations. Anything else they reply lands in Needs reply.
- Texts go only while Texting is set up for the office; in test mode, only to the test numbers.
